purpose: Fixed acceptance sample for AgentNexus collaborative-coding runs

tasks.title: Add flat-rate shipping override
tasks.story: A seller wants to force a fixed shipping cost for selected countries.
acceptance: shipping_flat_rate(country_code, configured_flat) returns the flat rate for known codes
unknown configured entries fall back to weight-based shipping_cost
unit tests cover both paths

tasks.title: Reject negative prices
tasks.story: Price feeds occasionally send negative unit prices; pricing must fail loudly.
acceptance: line_total raises ValueError for a negative unit_price
apply_discount still rejects negative amount
unit tests cover negative unit_price and quantity

tasks.title: Free shipping threshold
tasks.story: Orders over a configurable amount should ship free.
acceptance: shipping_cost accepts a free_shipping_threshold
amounts strictly above the threshold return 0.0
remote surcharge is waived too at/above threshold
unit tests cover boundary values

tasks.title: Remote-area zip prefixes
tasks.story: Remote shipping should use configurable zip prefixes instead of hardcoded ones.
acceptance: remote_zips are passed as a parameter with a safe default
prefix matching is case/padding stable
unit tests cover a configured prefix and the default list

tasks.title: Volume surcharge
tasks.story: Bulky packages cost more to ship.
acceptance: shipping_cost accepts volume_cm3 and adds a surcharge above 5000 cm3
non-bulky volume adds nothing
unit tests cover both sides of the boundary

tasks.title: Stable money rounding contract
tasks.story: Rounding must be deterministic across environments.
acceptance: round_money documents and implements half-up rounding to cents
1.005 and 2.675 round to 1.01 and 2.68
existing tests stay green

tasks.title: Extend tax table
tasks.story: Two new countries should be covered by default tax rates.
acceptance: tax_rate returns 0.21 for GB and 0.05 for CA when configured
unknown codes still raise KeyError
unit tests cover the new codes

tasks.title: Discount cap
tasks.story: A promotion must never discount more than a configurable percentage.
acceptance: apply_discount caps the effective percentage at discount_cap when provided
lower percentages are unaffected
unit tests cover below, at, and above the cap

tasks.title: Bundle stacking rule
tasks.story: Bundle discounts must stack with line discounts only when explicitly enabled.
acceptance: line_total accepts a bundle_discount_pct
stacking applies both discounts when enabled and only line discount otherwise
unit tests cover both modes

tasks.title: Express shipping option
tasks.story: Checkout needs an express tier with a flat premium.
acceptance: shipping_cost accepts express=True and adds the documented premium
premium is constant per weight tier
unit tests cover express and standard

tasks.title: Currency formatting
tasks.story: Totals should render with thousands separators and two decimals.
acceptance: negative values keep a '-' prefix
unit tests cover large and negative values

tasks.title: Order status validator
tasks.story: Status values must be validated before external APIs see them.
acceptance: validate_order_status accepts pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled
other values raise ValueError with the offending value
unit tests cover the full set

tasks.title: Reject zero-unit orders
tasks.story: An order with a zero quantity should be treated as a data error.
acceptance: line_total rejects quantity == 0 with a distinct ValueError message
the existing zero-quantity test is updated to the new contract
all other line totals stay valid

tasks.title: Numeric coercion guard
tasks.story: String prices from legacy feeds must be rejected instead of silently coerced.
acceptance: line_total raises TypeError when unit_price is not int/float
apply_discount raises TypeError for non-numeric amount
unit tests cover string and bool inputs

tasks.title: Max order weight
tasks.story: Packages above a weight limit must be refused with a clear error.
acceptance: shipping_cost raises ValueError above max_weight_g when provided
at-limit packages are accepted
unit tests cover at and above the limit

tasks.title: Discount code normalization
tasks.story: Discount codes arrive with mixed case and extra whitespace.
acceptance: normalize_discount_code trims and uppercases
empty codes raise ValueError
unit tests cover mixed case, padding, and empty input

tasks.title: Merge duplicate line items
tasks.story: Duplicate SKUs should merge quantities instead of producing two rows.
acceptance: merge_lines sums quantities for matching keys and keeps the rest
input lines are not mutated
unit tests cover duplicates and distinct lines

tasks.title: Minimum shipping charge
tasks.story: Some routes need a floor price even when weight is tiny.
acceptance: shipping_cost clamps the result to min_charge when provided
values above the floor are unchanged
unit tests cover below/above the floor

tasks.title: Tax-exempt flag
tasks.story: Resellers should be able to exempt an order from tax.
acceptance: order_total accepts tax_exempt=True and omits tax
standard orders still include configured tax
unit tests cover both flags

tasks.title: Order total summary
tasks.story: A single call should summarize subtotal, discount, tax, and shipping.
acceptance: order_summary returns a dict with subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, total
the total equals the sum of components rounded consistently
unit tests cover a taxed and an exempt order
